from itertools import permutations

def find_permutation(S):
    # Generate all permutations of the string S
    perm = permutations(S)
    # Convert each permutation tuple to a string
    perm_list = [''.join(p) for p in perm]
    # Sort the list of permutations lexicographically
    perm_list.sort()
